heading: Check your application or petition before you submit
headings_all: Check your application or petition before you submit
page_text_first_1500: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Evidence Review & Submit Review your Application Check your application or petition before you submit We will review your application or petition to check for accuracy and completeness before you submit it. We encourage you to provide as many responses as you can throughout the application or petition to ensure that it is complete, true, and accurate. You can return to this page to review your application or petition as many times as you want before you submit it. Alerts and warnings You have one or more alerts and warnings based on the information you provided in your application or petition. Form I-485 Your Form I-485 is missing Edit my responses Form G-28 Your Form G-28 is missing Edit my responses Your fee Your form filing fee is: $0.00 Refund Policy: USCIS does not refund fees, regardless of any action we take on your application, petition or request, or how long USCIS takes to reach a decision. _note: Page title 'USCIS | Review Your Submission'. Same trap as the I-765 review page: Next (testid next-btn) is DISABLED while items are missing, so a successful fill/upload run ENABLES it - the descriptor must mark this page kind:'review' and the terminal guard must cover /review on this host path. Only TWO alerts here (missing I-485 PDF, missing G-28); the fourteen evidence slots raise NO review alert, they only warn in-page when you click Next past an empty evidence step. Fee line read 'Your form filing fee is: $0.00' on this incomplete draft - treat that as unverified, not as the real I-485 fee; the fee almost certainly resolves once client information is completed. NOT advanced past this page: no submit, no payment, no signature.
